hero.emblemAlt: Two golden open hands reaching for each other through a loose golden ribbon
hero.eyebrow: Arcana Subclass · 0 · The Fool · Aspect of Curiosity

epigraph.html: We leap before we look, and the Weave catches us wherever we land.

hero.ledeHtml: Mystra wove the Unbound from the first step of every journey, a thread that answers only to curiosity and the open road. They wear no armour and strike with open hands and moving air, slipping past every blow until the ground itself stops holding them down. The Unbound is the Arcana's martial destiny: a fast, unarmoured striker who fights with fists and wind and turns every spell into one more blow. Pick it if you want to cross the battlefield in a single turn, reach every enemy before they act, and stay alive by never being where the hit lands.

blocks.html:
The Fool is card 0 of the Major Arcana. Every other Arcanum has a number that places it somewhere along the road; the Fool's zero places it before the road begins, which is why it can stand at the start of any journey. The card shows a young traveller at the edge of a cliff, a small bundle slung over one shoulder and a white flower in hand, a little dog at their heels. They are looking up at the sky, not down at the drop.

Read in a spread, the Fool means beginnings, freedom and trust: the step taken before you know where it leads, by someone who carries nothing that could hold them back. The traveller is not ignorant of the cliff. They simply believe the world will catch them.

That is the Unbound's destiny. Mystra wove them from the first step of every journey, so they travel light in the most literal sense: no armour, no weapon, nothing but open hands and the wind. In combat their curiosity pulls them towards every enemy on the field, and the Aspect of Curiosity awakens when they have touched as many of them as they can in a single round.

upright.title: Upright
upright.html: You go everywhere: a movement speed that keeps growing to level 20, long jumps, flight, and an Aspect that rewards reaching every enemy on the field.

reversed.title: Reversed
reversed.html: Your enemies are the ones who stumble: Gale Burst knocks them Prone and Wind Blast leaves them Off Balance. The only fall you take stops hurting by level 12.

blocks.html: You are a skirmisher who fights in melee without armour or weapons. A typical turn: cross the field with a movement speed no one else matches, hit with an unarmed attack (two from level 5), then spend your bonus action on a Zephyr Strike, the extra blow that follows every unarmed attack and every Arcane spell you cast. Your spells mostly strengthen you rather than the party: more bonus actions, more damage on your fists, flight, a reaction against arrows. You survive by not being hit. Dexterity and Wisdom both raise your Armour Class, enemies attack you at Disadvantage, and from level 12 every hit that lands deals only half damage.

blocks.title: At a Glance
blocks.html:
• Role: unarmoured unarmed striker and skirmisher
  • Strengths: the best mobility in the class, many attacks per turn, layered evasion, strong exploration (flight, long jumps, no falling damage)
  • Weaknesses: any armour or shield switches your features off; no healing beyond temporary hit points; little area damage or control
  • Tip: raise Dexterity first, then Wisdom. Be the Leaf adds both to your Armour Class, and Dexterity drives every unarmed attack and Storm Fists.

rows.label: Hit Points
rows.html: 6 + your Constitution modifier at level 1, then 4 + your Constitution modifier per level

rows.label: Secondary Ability
rows.html: Dexterity (Wisdom also adds to your Armour Class)

rows.label: Armour
rows.html: None. Every Unbound feature works only while you wear no armour and carry no shield.

rows.label: Skills
rows.html: Choose 4 from Acrobatics, Animal Handling, Arcana, Athletics, Nature, Perception, Sleight of Hand and Survival. Then gain Expertise in 2 of them.

rows.label: Suggested Abilities
rows.html: Strength 10, Dexterity 15, Constitution 10, Intelligence 15, Wisdom 13, Charisma 8, then a +2 and a +1 bonus

rows.label: Starting Equipment
rows.html: Unbound's Robe (cloth, Armour Class 10), Shoes, camp clothes, 2 Potions of Healing, a Scroll of Revivify. No weapon.

blocks.html: You fight with your fists, and three passives you gain at level 1 make them as good as any weapon. Flowing Strikes: Agility lets your unarmed attacks use Dexterity instead of Strength when your Dexterity is higher. Flowing Strikes: Precision sets the damage die of your unarmed attacks, which grows with your character level. From level 7, Magic Strikes makes them magical.

Unarmed damage (Flowing Strikes: Precision)
Character level1–34–67–910–12
Damage die1d41d61d81d10

Each unarmed attack deals that die plus your Dexterity (or Strength) modifier as Bludgeoning damage. If your normal unarmed damage is already higher, it is kept.

Zephyr Strike

The engine of the subclass is Flowing Strikes: Zephyr. Whenever you make an unarmed attack, cast an Arcane spell or cast True Strike, you can make a Zephyr Strike as a bonus action for the rest of that turn: one more unarmed attack against an enemy within reach. Every Unbound spell ends with the same line, "Afterwards, you can make a Zephyr Strike as a bonus action." A Zephyr Strike is itself an unarmed attack, so as long as you have bonus actions left, the next one is ready.

That makes bonus actions your real currency. You have one each turn, and these features add more:

  • Flow State (level 3): one additional bonus action each turn while it lasts, two when cast with a level 5 or 6 slot.
  • Restless Wind (Aspect Tier II, level 7): once per turn, a Zephyr Strike doesn't cost a bonus action.

Several Unbound spells (Wind Whispers, Storm Fists, Evasive Flow, Thunderclap) are cast as a bonus action themselves. Casting one still opens a Zephyr Strike, but you need a second bonus action to take it. From level 5, Flowing Assault gives your attack action a second, free attack.

blocks.title: A Level 5 Turn
blocks.html: With Flow State active from your previous turn: take the Attack action and hit with your fist, then make the free attack from Flowing Assault. Spend your bonus action on a Zephyr Strike, and the extra bonus action from Flow State on a second one. That is four unarmed attacks, each dealing 1d6 + your Dexterity modifier, and four chances to strike four different enemies for the Aspect of Curiosity.

The Unbound carries nothing that could hold them down. Every Unbound passive, spell and effect works only while you wear no armour and carry no shield. Clothing such as the Unbound's Robe is fine. Equipping armour or a shield switches your passives off and ends your active Unbound effects at once.

Armour Class

Be the Leaf sets your Armour Class to 10 + your Dexterity modifier + your Wisdom modifier. It doesn't stack with Mage Armour. Two passives add +2 more while their spell is active: Eye of the Storm (Untethered) and Momentum (Thunderclap).

Speed and the fall

Twinkle Toes raises your movement speed at almost every odd level, all the way to level 20. Feather Fall, from level 5, cuts your Falling damage and multiplies your Jump distance until you are Immune to falling at level 12.

intro.html: Every feature on this page works only while you wear no armour and carry no shield. Spells marked Combat only can't be cast outside combat.

features.name: Gale Burst
features.bodyHtml:
Channel the air into your fist and release it in a focused burst, launching your target backwards 6m and knocking it Prone.

If the target fails its Strength Saving Throw, it takes 1d10 Thunder damage, is pushed back 6m and falls Prone. If it succeeds, it takes half damage and stays where it is.

Afterwards, you can make a Zephyr Strike as a bonus action.

At higher levels: 2d10 Thunder and a 7m push with a level 3 or 4 slot, 3d10 Thunder and an 8m push with a level 5 or 6 slot.

features.name: True Strike
features.bodyHtml:
Gain Advantage on your next Attack Roll against the target.

Casting True Strike also lets you make a Zephyr Strike as a bonus action.

features.name: Be the Leaf
features.bodyHtml:
Your reflexes are as effective as armour. You add your Wisdom modifier to your Armour Class.

Your Armour Class is 10 + your Dexterity modifier + your Wisdom modifier. This effect does not stack with Mage Armour.

features.name: Twinkle Toes
features.bodyHtml:
You move lightly and swiftly. Your movement speed is increased by 3m.

The bonus grows at levels 3, 5, 7, 9, 11, 12, 13, 15, 17, 19 and 20, up to +68m (see Moving Air).

features.name: Flowing Strikes: Agility
features.bodyHtml: Your unarmed attacks scale with Dexterity instead of Strength if your Dexterity is higher.

features.name: Flowing Strikes: Precision
features.bodyHtml:
Your unarmed attacks deal 1d4 Bludgeoning damage, unless their normal damage is higher.

The die becomes 1d6 at level 4, 1d8 at level 7, 1d10 at level 10, 1d12 at level 13 and 1d20 at level 19.

features.name: Flowing Strikes: Zephyr
features.bodyHtml:
After making an unarmed attack or casting an Arcane spell, you can make a Zephyr Strike as a bonus action.

Casting True Strike opens a Zephyr Strike as well. See Open Hands.

features.name: Zephyr Strike
features.bodyHtml:
Swiftly strike an enemy as a bonus action.

An unarmed attack that deals your unarmed damage. It becomes available for the rest of the turn after an unarmed attack, an Arcane spell or True Strike, and costs no Woven Spell Slot.

features.name: Wind Blast
features.bodyHtml:
Bend the air to unleash a strong gust of wind that clears clouds and pushes creatures back 5m, leaving them Off Balance.

Creatures that fail a Strength Saving Throw are pushed back 5m and become Off Balance. The gust deals no damage, but it clears cloud surfaces and puts out Burning.

Afterwards, you can make a Zephyr Strike as a bonus action.

features.name: Flow State
features.bodyHtml:
Enter a temporary state of flow where you gain temporary hit points, and an additional bonus action.

You gain temporary hit points equal to twice your Arcana level, and one additional bonus action each turn while Flow State lasts.

Afterwards, you can make a Zephyr Strike as a bonus action.

features.name: Ready: Gale Deflection
features.bodyHtml:
Pull a thread of wind back into your reach. Until combat ends, you gain Gale Deflection and one use of it. You can hold up to 3 uses.

Casting it costs a Woven Spell Slot but no action, so you can ready a use whenever you have a slot to spare. Each deflection spends one use and your reaction.

features.name: Gale Deflection
features.bodyHtml:
Use your reaction to reduce the damage from a ranged weapon attack by 1d10 + your Dexterity modifier + your Arcana level. If the damage is reduced to 0, you can Deflect the Missile.

Gale Deflection: Redirect. Bend the air around the projectile and hurl it back at your attacker: an unarmed attack (range 18m) that deals your unarmed damage as Bludgeoning.

You can only reduce damage from the attack. Any additional effects can't be negated.

features.name: 0 - The Fool: Awakening
features.bodyHtml:
Strike different enemies with attacks within a single round to awaken the Aspect of Curiosity until combat ends. Each goal you reach awakens one more tier.

At level 3, strike 3 different enemies to gain Wanderlust. Tiers II and III join at levels 7 and 12. The full rule is in Aspect of Curiosity.

features.name: Twinkle Toes
features.bodyHtml: Your movement speed bonus becomes +8m.

features.name: Wind Whispers
features.bodyHtml:
You can sense movement in the air. Attack Rolls against you have Disadvantage, and when an enemy's melee attack misses you, you use your reaction to strike back with an unarmed attack.

The counterattack is Wind Riposte. It needs the attacker within 2m and your reaction available. The effect ends early if you are Incapacitated.

Afterwards, you can make a Zephyr Strike as a bonus action.

features.name: Flowing Assault
features.bodyHtml:
You can make an additional free attack after making an unarmed or weapon attack.

It works like Extra Attack: when you attack using your action, you can attack once more for free.

features.name: Feather Fall
features.bodyHtml:
You take only 50% of Falling damage, and your Jump distance is multiplied by 2.

It improves at levels 7, 9, 11 and 12, where you become Immune to Falling damage and jump six times as far (see Moving Air).

features.name: Twinkle Toes
features.bodyHtml: Your movement speed bonus becomes +13m.

features.name: Storm Fists
features.bodyHtml:
The wind flows through your hands. Your unarmed attacks deal an additional 1d4 + Dexterity modifier Thunder damage.

Afterwards, you can make a Zephyr Strike as a bonus action.

At higher levels: 1d6 + Dexterity modifier Thunder for 4 turns with a level 5 slot, 1d8 + Dexterity modifier Thunder for 5 turns with a level 6 slot.

features.name: Magic Strikes
features.bodyHtml: Your unarmed attacks count as magical, ignoring Resistance and Immunity to non-magical damage.

features.name: Aspect of Curiosity: Tier II
features.bodyHtml: Strike 4 different enemies within a single round to also gain Restless Wind. See Aspect of Curiosity.

features.name: Feather Fall
features.bodyHtml: You take only 40% of Falling damage, and your Jump distance is multiplied by 3.

features.name: Twinkle Toes
features.bodyHtml: Your movement speed bonus becomes +18m.

features.name: Untethered
features.bodyHtml:
Freed from earthly ties, gain the ability to Fly.

While Untethered, you can Fly to a target position. Each flight costs movement equal to half the distance flown, and no bonus action. Cast in combat, it lasts until combat ends. Cast outside combat, it lasts until you enter combat, so it is a tool for exploration more than an opener. While it is active, Eye of the Storm gives you +2 Armour Class.

Afterwards, you can make a Zephyr Strike as a bonus action.

features.name: Evasive Flow
features.bodyHtml:
Leap into an opening. Jumping no longer requires a bonus action, and your next unarmed attack this turn has Advantage.

Free jumps leave your bonus actions for Zephyr Strikes, and Feather Fall makes each jump cover a lot of ground.

Afterwards, you can make a Zephyr Strike as a bonus action.

At higher levels: lasts 3 turns with a level 6 slot.

features.name: Eye of the Storm
features.bodyHtml: While Untethered is active, the air surrounds your body, protecting you. You gain a bonus of +2 to your Armour Class.

features.name: Feather Fall
features.bodyHtml: You take only 30% of Falling damage, and your Jump distance is multiplied by 4.

features.name: Twinkle Toes
features.bodyHtml: Your movement speed bonus becomes +23m.

features.name: Thunderclap
features.bodyHtml:
When you deal Thunder damage, inflict 2 turns of Reverberation upon the target.

It triggers once per attack. Your Thunder damage comes from Gale Burst, Storm Fists, Wanderlust and Leap of Faith, so combining them stacks Reverberation quickly. While Thunderclap is active, Momentum gives you +2 Armour Class. You gain this spell when your slots are level 6, so it always lasts 5 turns.

Afterwards, you can make a Zephyr Strike as a bonus action.

features.name: Momentum
features.bodyHtml: While Thunderclap is active, you gain a bonus of +2 to your Armour Class.

features.name: Feather Fall
features.bodyHtml: You take only 20% of Falling damage, and your Jump distance is multiplied by 5.

features.name: Twinkle Toes
features.bodyHtml: Your movement speed bonus becomes +28m.

features.name: Empty State
features.bodyHtml:
Your agility lets you dodge incoming attacks and certain spells. When an attack hits you, you take only half damage.

When a spell or effect allows a Dexterity Saving Throw for half damage, you take no damage on a success, and only half damage on a failure.

features.name: Aspect of Curiosity: Tier III
features.bodyHtml: Strike 5 different enemies within a single round to awaken as the Aspect of Curiosity. See Aspect of Curiosity.

features.name: Feather Fall
features.bodyHtml: You are Immune to Falling damage, and your Jump distance is multiplied by 6.

features.name: Twinkle Toes
features.bodyHtml: Your movement speed bonus becomes +38m.

blocks.html:
At level 3 you gain 0 - The Fool: Awakening. In combat, curiosity pulls you towards every enemy on the field: strike different enemies with attacks within a single round, and the Aspect of Curiosity awakens in you until combat ends.

  • What counts: any attack that hits an enemy. Unarmed attacks, Zephyr Strikes, Wind Riposte, a missile hurled back with Gale Deflection and attack spells all count.
  • The round runs from the start of your turn to the start of your next one, so hits you land with reactions during enemy turns count too.
  • Few enemies left: if fewer enemies stand when your turn begins than a goal asks for, every hit counts towards that goal, even on the same enemy. A duel can still awaken you.
  • Awakening Progress, a status on your portrait, shows the hits that count towards your next tier this round. It resets when your turn begins.
  • Each goal is checked on its own, so a single busy round can awaken several tiers at once. Every tier you reach stays until combat ends, and each one adds to the last.

feature.name: Leap of Faith
feature.bodyHtml:
Dash through the fray, striking every creature in your path with an unarmed attack that also deals 1d8 Thunder damage.

Available once you reach Tier I, and it costs no Woven Spell Slot. The Thunder damage grows with your character level: 1d8 at levels 3–4, 2d8 at 5–8, 3d8 at 9–12, 4d8 at 13–16 and 5d8 at 17–20. A dash through a crowd is also the fastest way to strike several different enemies for the next tier.

Afterwards, you can make a Zephyr Strike as a bonus action.
